title: Change Is In The Air
summary:
What will be the impact of Worldscale changes for 2023
In the coming weeks, Worldscale will publish the 2023 Flat Rates. In most other years, bunker prices are the primary driver for changes in the flat rates. However, this year the Worldscale organization decided to make additional changes to their assumptions.
